name: Swedish A1
description: In this module, students gain basic knowledge of Swedish as a foreign language, enabling them with minimal language skills to successfully manage basic everyday situations. They learn/practice fundamental vocabulary concerning family, career, leisure time, Swedisch culture and society and to talk about these topics in the present tense, using simply-structured main and subordinate clauses. They learn plural forms of nouns; personal, reflexive, demonstrative and selected possessive pronouns; simple forms of negation; the use of selected modal verbs and prepositions; adjectival declination.
